test_title: PYST 50: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the phrase in bold.

Your so-called friend has **cooked your goose.**

options.text: To complete a lot of work or a wide range of things
When something develops completely and reaches maturity; when a child becomes an adult
To spend a lot of time and energy but achieve nothing
To interfere with, disrupt or ruin something for someone

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"cooked your goose"** means to interfere with, disrupt, or ruin something for someone. (किसी के लिए कुछ गड़बड़ करना, बाधित करना या बर्बाद करना)

 
 
• **Example: **John's careless remarks during the meeting have really **cooked his goose**; the boss is very upset with him.
 
 
 
• **"Disrupt" **refers to interrupting an event, activity, or process by causing a disturbance or problem. (बाधा डालना)
 
 
• **Example: **The loud noise from the construction site **disrupted **our meeting.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the meaning of **'cooked your goose' **is **'to interfere with, disrupt or ruin something for someone'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: To complete a lot of work or a wide range of things** (कई काम या बहुत सी चीजें पूरी करना)

 
 
• **Example:** She managed to complete a lot of work before the deadline.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: When something develops completely and reaches maturity; when a child becomes an adult** (जब कुछ पूरी तरह से विकसित हो जाता है और परिपक्वता तक पहुंचता है; जब एक बच्चा एक वयस्क बन जाता है)
 
 
• **Example: **His business has now reached maturity and is thriving.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: To spend a lot of time and energy but achieve nothing** (बहुत समय और ऊर्जा खर्च करना लेकिन कुछ भी हासिल न करना)
 
 
• **Example:** After months of effort, he realized he had been spinning his wheels and had achieved nothing.
 
 

3b:Tbc5,

The correct answer is: **Option 3.**
